cases.purpose: With BASHBLKID_SYS_BLOCK_DIR/BASHBLKID_DEV_ROOT pointing at an independently built sysfs-like tree and ext2 images, no-operand enumeration probes exactly the entries that have a device file with content (skipping hidden, device-less and empty entries), and -L/-U search that set printing the device path, status 2 on a miss, usage status 2 for both flags.
cases.oracle: ext2 images made by e2fsprogs mke2fs with known labels and UUIDs; expected set, paths and statuses derive from the documented override semantics, not from candidate output.
cases.comparison: Candidate output, status and files compared with values derived independently of candidate output.
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p dev sys/vda1 sys/vda2 sys/vdb sys/ghost sys/vdc sys/.hidden
for n in vda1 vda2 vdb; do /usr/bin/truncate -s 2M dev/$n; done
: > dev/vdc
/usr/sbin/mke2fs -q -t ext2 -L ROOT -U 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 dev/vda1
/usr/sbin/mke2fs -q -t ext2 -L DATA -U 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 dev/vda2
/usr/sbin/mke2fs -q -t ext2 -L SCRATCH -U 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333 dev/vdb
printf '1\n' > sys/vda1/partition; printf '2\n' > sys/vda2/partition
printf 'vda\n' > sys/vda1/parent; printf 'vda\n' > sys/vda2/parent
cases.script:
export BASHBLKID_SYS_BLOCK_DIR=$PWD/sys BASHBLKID_DEV_ROOT=$PWD/dev
b() { "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
out=$(b 'blkid -s UUID -o value'); echo "enumerate status=$?"
mapfile -t A <<<"$out"
for ((i=0;i<${#A[@]};i++)); do for ((j=i+1;j<${#A[@]};j++)); do [[ ${A[j]} < ${A[i]} ]] && { t=${A[i]}; A[i]=${A[j]}; A[j]=$t; }; done; done
printf 'uuid %s\n' "${A[@]}"
r() { local l=$1; shift; local o; o=$(b "$*"); local rc=$?; printf '%s status=%s out=[%s]\n' "$l" $rc "$o"; }
r label-hit 'blkid -L DATA'
r label-miss 'blkid -L NOSUCH'
r uuid-hit 'blkid -U 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333'
r uuid-miss 'blkid -U 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999'
r both-flags 'blkid -L DATA -U 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333'
out=$(b 'blkid -s LABEL -o value'); mapfile -t A <<<"$out"; echo "labels=${#A[@]}"
cases.stdout:
enumerate status=0
uuid 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
uuid 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222
uuid 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333
label-hit status=0 out=[/tmp/parity-case/dev/vda2]
label-miss status=2 out=[]
uuid-hit status=0 out=[/tmp/parity-case/dev/vdb]
uuid-miss status=2 out=[]
both-flags status=2 out=[]
labels=3
